name: br-inss
description: Brazil INSS individual-contributor social security for 2026. Distinguishes own-account normal20% contributions, eligible simplified11%, ordinary company withholding and MEI/facultative referrals. Covers the current floor/ceiling, same-month concurrent employment and multiple payers, monthly GPS and DAS identities/timing, reduced-plan benefit limits and complements, ordinary late charges and historic indemnity boundaries. Trigger on INSSautonomo, contribuinteindividual, GPS1007/1163/1295, tetoINSS, simplified plan, PJretencao11%, CLTplusautonomo and no-income months. Includes a plan-cost decision and company-withholding ceiling reconciliation, plus preserved edge cases and tests. Excludes employee payroll computation, complete benefit eligibility, treaty certificates, specialist payer/MEI exceptions, refunds and historic-period recognition not verified here.
